description: VTID-05276 (plan kiro-autonomy-fallback §4.3): protected gate files. A change to one never merges on a reviewer-agent accept alone; it needs a legacy claude review on the current head or the owner's instruction. Globs use scripts/collab/queue.mjs globToRegex semantics. Owned by scripts/collab/queue.mjs (compiled-in copy for single-file runs); the Project Manager mirrors it in governance.ts.
